_note: Media model registry (fal.ai endpoints). Prices are list prices researched Nov 2026 from fal pricing roundups and MUST be re-verified weekly by the self-improver (model-scouting skill). Endpoint ids marked verify:true have not been confirmed against fal's live model pages. The gateway setting `model_registry` overrides this file when present.

budget_i2v.use: cheap b-roll, drafts, lifestyle scene motion

standard_i2v.use: default product b-roll and hook shots

hero_i2v.use: hero/hook shot where product fidelity and motion quality matter most

premium_i2v.use: premium hero shots when standard models fail fidelity

native_audio.use: scenes needing synchronized ambient sound or speech

open_weights.use: fallback when proprietary models refuse or are down

presenter.use: AI presenter / talking-head explainer (never a fake customer)

product_edit.use: reference-faithful product edits: new background, hands, context

hero.use: hero image when product_edit fails fidelity

remove_bg.use: product cutouts for motion graphics and statics

music.use: original background music (royalty-free for ads; check vendor terms)

deprecated.status: shut down 2026-09-24 per OpenAI deprecation notice
